name: The king of shadows
summary:
The Bat King has awakened... and he needs your blood to survive.

In a world where the sun has vanished and darkness rules the skies, winged nightmares descend from above, hunting anything that dares to breathe. Cities lie in ruins. Hope is all but gone. From the shadows, a new evil rises — the Bat King, an ancient creature that feeds on fear... and on blood.

You are the last beacon of resistance.

Armed with speed, instinct, and whatever weapons you can find, you must face relentless waves of demonic bats
